headline: KC surges 50.00% marking its strongest 5‑day gain in the PROP sector.
market_take: Prop sector activity dominated the market with KC up 50.00% and PF down 20.00%, while several PROP stocks posted double‑digit moves. Food stocks showed heightened volatility, highlighted by AQUA's -10.00% intraday drop and CHOTI's 100% open price gap. Unusual‑trading alerts were abundant, especially volume spikes in AGRI (TL) and PFREIT (AMATAR). High‑impact filings this week include A5's trading suspension, AKS's potential delisting signal, and capital reductions at CPNCG and CPF.

sector_notes.note: KC (+50.00%) and PRECHA (+12.20%) led gains, while PF (-20.00%) and JCK (-7.69%) fell; A5 received a trading suspension filing and AKS flagged for possible delisting.
AQUA dropped -10.00% intraday with a 3.51× volume surge; CHOTI and XBIO experienced 100% and -14.29% open price gaps respectively; NRF rose +8.70% intraday.
TRITN fell -33.33% and PLE slipped -11.11% after open‑gap alerts; SQ faced a demand letter over defaulted debentures.
TL declined -6.82% but posted a 4.9σ volume spike; TFM and PPPM also showed notable volume or price moves.
AMATAR recorded a 4.4σ volume spike; CPNCG announced a high‑impact capital reduction, and TTLPF also reduced paid‑up capital.
